# Referee v0.1.0

Referee is a Go middleware proxy that applies policy to Model Context Protocol
(MCP) tool calls. An agent's MCP client connects to Referee, which forwards
authorized requests to a configured upstream tool server.

## Policy and decisions

- YAML policies define tool capabilities, task classes, and source rules.
- Referee represents provenance and sensitivity separately. The gate can check
  capability scope, integrity, and confidentiality before forwarding a call.
- Operators can configure expiring task capabilities, policy-authorized
  argument redaction, and human approval for requests requiring a challenge.

## Receipts and operations

Referee records hash-chained decisions and supports signed batch-head
verification. It HMACs argument evidence instead of writing raw tool arguments
into receipts. Operators can export receipt metadata over OTLP/HTTP while
retaining the on-disk log as the source of record.

Referee supports stdio and streamable HTTP in JSON mode. See the threat model
for assumptions and limitations before deploying.
